c1.note: Capital One's Jan 22, 2026 release announces the Brex acquisition in a stock-and-cash deal valued at $5.15B; all variants are consistent, including the 50/50 split per CNBC.

c2.note: CNBC says the purchase is 50% cash and 50% stock; the 8-K's roughly $2.75B cash against $5.15B total is about 53%, so the split is approximate.

c3.note: CNBC reports the bank disclosed the deal in its Q4 2025 earnings statement, alongside a separate press release.

c4.note: The 8-K confirms the acquisition closed on April 7, 2026 for cash plus stock, so Brex is no longer independent.

c5.note: TechCrunch calls $12.3B the last private valuation, from the 2022 Series D-2 round (announced Jan 2022, term sheet Oct 2021).

c8.note: 5.15/12.3 is about 42%, so the sale price is more than 50% below the peak, as CNBC and TechCrunch say.

c9.note: Banking Dive cites PitchBook for a sale price nearly 60% below the $12.3B valuation, which it dates to 2021.

c10.note: Banking Dive says 2021 while TechCrunch says 2022, so sources do differ on the year.

c11.note: The closing 8-K states approximately $2.56B in cash and 10,646,306 shares of Capital One common stock.

c13.note: The January 8-K states $5.15B consisting of about $2.75B in cash and about 10.6M shares.

c14.note: Investing.com cites $2.56B cash at closing against Banking Dive's $2.75B at announcement; the gap is announced versus closed amounts, not a conflict.

c15.note: The 10-Q says the Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization is dated January 22, 2026.

c17.note: Completion release says Franceschi will continue as CEO of Brex; Brex is part of Capital One.

c18.note: Acquisition completed April 7, 2026, so Brex has no independent private valuation.

c21.note: Logically follows from completed acquisition; deal price is a historical transaction measure.

c22.note: Filings state approx. $4.5B total consideration paid to Brex shareholders; the Q3 10-Q repeats it.

c25.note: $4,521M is the fair value as of the April 7 closing; $5.15B was the announced headline value.

c29.note: Series D-2 brought total raised to $1.2B as of Jan 2022; historical.

c30.note: Brex raised $300M in Series D-2 at a $12.3B valuation in Jan 2022; historical.

c31.note: Capital One's Q2 2026 filing says fair value estimates for acquired assets and liabilities are provisional as of June 30, 2026, and gives $4,521M purchase consideration at the April 7 close.

c32.note: The January 22, 2026 release says the deal was expected to close in the middle of calendar 2026. It closed April 7, so this is stale background.

c33.note: Stock was part of the consideration, so value floated. The 10-Q puts fair-value purchase consideration at $4,521M ($1,891M stock plus $2,630M cash) versus the $5.15B headline. Variant D's 'half' is roughly right, since stock was about 42% at closing value, but the claim holds.

c14.note: Investing.com, reporting the 8-K for the completed deal, gives about $2.56B in cash plus 10,646,306 COF shares. Banking Dive, citing the January filing, says $2.75B cash plus 10.6M shares. The two figures do differ. No source checked showed $2.58B, but it falls inside the claimed range.

c15.note: Investing.com, from the 8-K: the deal was done under a previously disclosed merger agreement dated January 22, 2026. That matches the date of Capital One's announcement.

c17.note: Capital One's April 7, 2026 completion release says the acquisition closed and 'Franceschi will continue as CEO of Brex.' Brex is now owned by Capital One. The release does not use the exact words 'business unit'.

c29.note: Business Wire release of Jan 11, 2022: 'Since the company's founding in 2017, Brex has raised a total of $1.2 billion from investors,' valued at $12.3B.
